['Leopold Kostal GmbH & Co. KG '].company_description: Leopold Kostal GmbH & Co. KG is a global company specializing in the development and production of components for automotive electrics. The company operates in various divisions, including the contact systems division, automotive electrics, industrial electrics, and testing technology divisions. The Automotive Electrics division, one of the key focus areas, encompasses four departments: Comfort Electronics (Develops control units, particularly for door control, seat control, and tailgate control units.), Power Electronics (Specializes in chargers and converters, including onboard chargers, on-board converters, and charging control units), Comfort Controls (Focuses on control elements within the vehicle interior, such as steering wheel switches, light switches, window regulators, seat adjusters, climate control units, driving mode switches, etc. Also involved in the production of roof modules, covering interior lighting, sunroof controls, etc. Manufactures various sensors, including motion sensors, interior cameras, climate sensors, microphones, rain/light sensors, etc.), Drive Controls (Specializes in steering column modules and selector levers.)

['Handelsgesellschaft Peter Cremer mbH '.company_description: Handelsgesellschaft Peter Cremer mbH operates in the areas of wholesale and foreign trade with various goods, particularly agricultural products such as grains, animal feed, and oilseeds. It also engages in the production and trade of oleochemical products. The company's subsidiary, Cremer North America, is involved in contract manufacturing, oleochemical sourcing, and chemical services. Additionally, the company has expanded its European molasses business and is focusing on the growth potential of new protein sources in its strategic food business area.
